description: This file defines the LocalActionDefault class, which provides a default implementation for local action plugins in Drupal. It includes methods for retrieving route information, titles, weights, cache settings, and route parameters, and implements several interfaces related to plugins, caching, and dependency injection.

classes.name: LocalActionDefault
classes.description: A default implementation for local action plugins in Drupal, handling route retrieval, title, weight, cache settings, and route parameters.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the route provider dependency.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate the class with dependencies from the container.

methods.name: getRouteName
methods.description: Returns the route name from plugin definition.

methods.name: getTitle
methods.description: Returns the title for the local action, possibly translatable.

methods.name: getWeight
methods.description: Returns the weight of the local action.

methods.name: getRouteParameters
methods.description: Retrieves route parameters, combining raw and matched parameters.

methods.name: getOptions
methods.description: Returns options for the route match.

methods.name: getCacheTags
methods.description: Returns cache tags associated with the plugin.

methods.name: getCacheContexts
methods.description: Returns cache contexts associated with the plugin.

methods.name: getCacheMaxAge
methods.description: Returns cache max age, defaulting to permanent if not set.
